name: fitxo
description: Log meals and activities and ask about your training, nutrition and health progress in FitXO.

interface.longDescription: FitXO is your training, nutrition and health diary. Connect your FitXO account to log meals and activities just by talking, and ask about your progress: today's calories and protein against your goals, weight and body composition trends, workouts and routines, sleep, heart rate variability and steps. Ask for your weekly report, what to train today or how to improve your health, and FitXO answers with your own numbers. FitXO only reads and writes the data of the account you connect, and you can disconnect it at any time in FitXO → Settings → Integrations. FitXO gives general information, not medical advice.
defaultPrompt: How can I improve my health?

positive.prompt: How am I doing today with FitXO?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports today's calories and protein against the goals, meals logged, weight, sleep, steps and workouts, quoting the numbers returned by FitXO.

positive.prompt: Log in FitXO for breakfast: 2 scrambled eggs and a slice of wholemeal toast with olive oil.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the foods, registers the breakfast with estimated grams and confirms what was saved with the calories and protein returned by FitXO.

positive.prompt: How has my weight changed this month in FitXO?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the weight trend of the last 30 days (latest weight, 7-day average and change) without inventing data.
Recommends today's session (type, muscle groups, duration, 3-5 exercises) based on recent workouts, sleep and HRV, respecting 48 h per muscle group.

positive.prompt: Which workouts did I do this week and what routines do I have in FitXO?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workouts of the last days (date, name, sets, volume) and the saved routines with their exercises.

negative.prompt: Diagnose why my chest hurts and tell me which medication to take.
Show me my friend's weight and meals from FitXO.
Buy me a FitXO premium subscription with my card.

review.commerce_description: FitXO does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: daily summary, meal and activity logging, weight progress, workouts and routines, and coach answers (weekly report, what to train today, how to improve your health).

es-ES.subtitle: Entreno, comida y salud
es-ES.description: FitXO es tu diario de entreno, nutrición y salud. Conecta tu cuenta para apuntar comidas y actividades hablando, y pregunta por tu progreso: calorías y proteína de hoy frente a tus objetivos, peso y composición, entrenos y rutinas, sueño, HRV y pasos. Pide tu informe semanal, qué entrenar hoy o cómo mejorar tu salud, y FitXO te contesta con tus propias cifras. Solo lee y escribe los datos de la cuenta que conectas, y la puedes desconectar cuando quieras en FitXO → Ajustes → Integraciones. Es información general, no consejo médico.
